title: Hinomori Shiho — What Made My Sadness Go Away〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: What Made My Sadness Go Away（4★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great practice today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, look! The moon's out even though it's barely dusk!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're right. That's pretty rare...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It could be because the sky's been so clear today. You can even see a lot of its features.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope it'll be even more beautiful on the night of the 15th.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be nice to see a big, round moon during a really clear night...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Big, round moon...?
You sound like a little kid.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, do you remember how you celebrated this time of year when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When we were little?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I vaguely remember doing some moon viewings, but not much more than that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I want to say that dango was on the lunch menu during elementary school, I think...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right! I remember that!
The teachers made them from scratch and they were so good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even learned how to make it from them and brought some along one time for a field trip.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I remember that too.
You spilled soy glaze everywhere, got your hands all sticky and cried about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Luckily, Honami saved the day by making sure to bring wet wipes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, I don't remember that part at all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, the memories.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Didn't we also make collages out of fallen leaves during that field trip?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
Saki made something moon related, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, she did!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still remember what you made too, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You do? What did I make...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You made Miku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, and you were adamant about using only green leaves to make her. But it was fall, so we had a really tough time finding enough for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that! Then, Hona suggested that you paint some green instead and it all worked out in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that what happened...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! That was when you were really into Miku, right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were even humming some Miku songs while you put your collage together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you recommended us a lot of Miku songs back then. You were so desperate about getting us to listen to them too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember that too. It was so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Stop, please, I feel really embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: However, Honami, I still remember exactly what you made...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
What did I make...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You made Shibao, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and Ichika were so confused by your initial sketch too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we totally were! Ichi even thought that Shibao was an octopus at first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it was also really cool how it clearly became a puppy in the end!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was pretty interesting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It was...?
I recall that it turned out okay but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Shiho just sat there really silently while she made hers... It was a band playing a show, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it was so incredible how detailed Shiho's was.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think that was just about the time my dad started taking me to live houses...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those shows are still fresh in my head too. That's probably what I was trying to recreate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I sort of bit off more than I could chew and ended up with just the band on stage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, your attention to detail was like your way of putting your signature on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. You were so focused that you didn't even look our way when we tried calling your name.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't remember that happening...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Nostalgia really is a powerful thing, isn't it? Especially when it comes to our childhood memories.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wanna head over to SEKAI and go through some pictures from back then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll bring some field trip and moon viewing albums!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That sounds nice. How about after practice, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Fine...
But no slacking off during practice, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, time to hunt down those albums♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too.
